Themes style everything that is not data: panel, grid, text, legend chrome, and layer defaults.
Start from a preset, override individual elements with [`theme`](../reference/themes/theme.qmd), and install a project-wide default with [`theme-set`](../reference/themes/theme-set.qmd).
The [theming guide](../guides/theming.qmd) walks through the element model behind these examples.
Every example ships its full source: click **View source** to copy it.
